```{r setup}
# | label: setup
# | include: false

library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(rstan)
library(ggpubr)
library(scales)
library(knitr)
library(sf)
library(scales)
library(ggrepel)
library(ggspatial)
library(ggh4x)
library(cowplot)
library(patchwork)


source(here("Scripts", "data_prep_functions.R"))
source(here("Scripts", "plot_functions.R"))

dataset <- "Full"

case_data <- load_case_data()
case_age_data <- load_case_age_data()
population_data <- load_population_data()
sero_data <- load_sero_data()
map_data <- st_read(here("Analysis_data", "thailand_map.shp"))
```

```{r data-config}
# | label: data-config

# Define areas
if(dataset == "Full") {
    area  <- case_data %>% distinct(Area) %>% pull(Area)
} else {
    area  <- c("Chiang Rai", "Lampang",  "Nakhon Ratchasima", "Surin", "Songkhla", "Phatthalung", "Uttaradit", "Tak")
}
# 
# Time period
start_year <- 2003
end_year   <- 2024
n_periods  <- 4

# Seasonality
n_harmonics <- 3

# Serology survey years (Gonwong et al. 2022)
sero_years <- c(2007, 2008, 2012)

# Fixed epidemiological parameters
omega <- 0.1882           # immune waning rate
nu <- 0.15                # clinical sign probability
sigma_lambda_0 <- 0.1     # baseline FOI variation
sigma_lambda_y <- 0.122   # year-to-year FOI variation
sigma_lambda_init <- 0.75 # initial FOI variation

# Reference age group for susceptibility normalization
ref_age_label <- "25 to 35"

age_levels <- c("0 to 5", "5 to 15", "15 to 25", "25 to 35",
                "35 to 45", "45 to 55", "55 to 65", "above 65")

  # Population age group mapping (raw -> standardized)
pop_age_levels = c("0 to 4", "5 to 14", "15 to 24", "25 to 34",
                    "35 to 44", "45 to 54", "55 to 64", "above 65")

config <- list(
  areas = area,
  start_year = start_year,
  end_year = end_year,
  n_periods = n_periods,
  n_harmonics = n_harmonics,
  sero_years = sero_years,
  omega = omega,
  nu = nu,
  sigma_lambda_0 = sigma_lambda_0,
  sigma_lambda_y = sigma_lambda_y,
  sigma_lambda_init = sigma_lambda_init,
  ref_age_label = ref_age_label,
  age_levels = age_levels,
  pop_age_levels = pop_age_levels
)
```

```{r data-preparation}
data <- prepare_stan_data(config)

stan_data <- data$stan_data
calendar <- data$calendar
site_levels <- data$site_levels
region_levels <- data$region_levels
age_levels <- data$age_levels

# Save prepared data
save(
  stan_data, calendar, site_levels, region_levels, age_levels,
  file = here("Rout", paste("stan_data_", dataset, ".RData", sep = ""))
)

cat("Dimensions:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Provinces (S): %d\n", stan_data$S))
cat(sprintf("  Regions (R): %d\n", stan_data$R))
cat(sprintf("  Years (Y): %d\n", stan_data$Y))
cat(sprintf("  Months (T): %d\n", stan_data$T))
cat(sprintf("  Age groups (A): %d\n", stan_data$A))
cat(sprintf("  Periods (P): %d\n", stan_data$P))
cat(sprintf("  Harmonics (H): %d\n", stan_data$H))
```

```{r model-settings}
model_settings <- data.frame(
  iter = getOption("stan.iter", 2000),
  warmup = getOption("stan.warmup", 1000),
  chains = getOption("stan.chains", 4),
  thin = getOption("stan.thin", 4),
  seed = getOption("stan.seed", 124L)
)

model_file <-  "model9_CFR.stan"

save(model_settings, model_file, file = here("Rout", paste("model_settings_", dataset, ".RData", sep = "")))
```

Model Fitting

}

```{r setup}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(rstan)
library(ggpubr)
library(scales)
library(knitr)

# Load fitted model and data
load(here("Rout", "fit_09.RData"))
load(here("Rout", "stan_data_09.RData"))

# Extract dimensions
S <- stan_data$S
T <- stan_data$T
Y <- stan_data$Y
A <- stan_data$A
P <- stan_data$P
M <- stan_data$M
R <- stan_data$R

# Year range
year_range <- range(calendar$year)
```

## Executive Summary

This analysis presents a Bayesian hierarchical model (Model 9) for scrub typhus transmission dynamics across `r S` provinces in Thailand from `r year_range[1]` to `r year_range[2]`. The model incorporates:

-   **Age-stratified susceptibility** (`r A` age groups)
-   **Temporal trends** in force of infection with seasonal variation
-   **Regional variation** in case detection sensitivity
-   **Case-fatality rate estimation** by age and period

------------------------------------------------------------------------

 Value = c(S, R, Y, T, A, P),
 Details = c(
   paste(site_levels, collapse = ", "),
   paste(unique(region_levels), collapse = ", "),

## 2. Model Diagnostics

### 2.1 Convergence Summary

```{r convergence}
#| label: convergence

# Extract summary statistics
fit_summary <- summary(fit)$summary

# Key parameters to check
key_params <- c("phi_case", "phi_death", "mu_log_lambda_0", 
               "sigma_Se", "sigma_rho", "sigma_CFR", "mu_logit_CFR")

convergence_tbl <- fit_summary[key_params, c("mean", "sd", "2.5%", "97.5%", "n_eff", "Rhat")] |>
 as.data.frame() |>
 rownames_to_column("Parameter") |>
 mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(.x, 3)))

kable(convergence_tbl, caption = "Convergence diagnostics for key parameters")
```

### 2.2 Posterior Predictive Check: Cases

```{r ppc-function}
#| label: ppc-function

# Function to compute PPC for a province
ppc_cases_by_province <- function(s_idx) {
 C_mat <- as.matrix(fit, pars = "C_ts")
 phi_vec <- as.numeric(as.matrix(fit, pars = "phi_case"))
 
 idx <- stringr::str_match(colnames(C_mat), "C_ts\\[(\\d+),(\\d+)\\]")
 t_idx_col <- as.integer(idx[, 2])
 s_idx_col <- as.integer(idx[, 3])
 
 param_map <- tibble(par = colnames(C_mat), t_idx = t_idx_col, s = s_idx_col) |>
   filter(s == s_idx)
 
 C_long <- as_tibble(C_mat[, param_map$par, drop = FALSE]) |>
   mutate(.draw = row_number()) |>
   pivot_longer(cols = -.draw, names_to = "par", values_to = "C_expected") |>
   left_join(param_map, by = "par")
 
 phi_df <- tibble(.draw = seq_len(nrow(C_mat)), phi = phi_vec)
 
 pred_summ <- C_long |>
   left_join(phi_df, by = ".draw") |>
   group_by(t_idx) |>
   summarize(
     mu_median = median(C_expected),
     yrep_q025 = quantile(rnbinom(n(), size = phi, mu = C_expected), 0.025),
     yrep_q500 = quantile(rnbinom(n(), size = phi, mu = C_expected), 0.50),
     yrep_q975 = quantile(rnbinom(n(), size = phi, mu = C_expected), 0.975),
     .groups = "drop"
   )
 
 calendar |>
   filter(s == s_idx) |>
   select(t_idx, Area, year, Month, observed_case = case) |>
   left_join(pred_summ, by = "t_idx") |>
   mutate(
     date = as.Date(sprintf("%d-%02d-01", year, Month)),
     province = site_levels[s_idx]
   )
}
```

```{r ppc-plots}
#| label: ppc-plots
#| fig-cap: "Posterior predictive check: Observed (black points) vs predicted (blue ribbon = 95% PI)"
#| fig-height: 10

# Generate PPC for all provinces
ppc_all <- map_dfr(seq_len(S), ppc_cases_by_province)

ggplot(ppc_all, aes(x = date)) +
 geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = yrep_q025, ymax = yrep_q975), fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.25) +
 geom_line(aes(y = yrep_q500), color = "steelblue", linewidth = 0.6) +
 geom_point(aes(y = observed_case), color = "black", size = 0.8, alpha = 0.5) +
 facet_wrap(~province, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
 labs(x = NULL, y = "Reported Cases", 
      title = "Posterior Predictive Check: Monthly Cases") +
 theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
 theme(strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey90"))
```

## 3. Epidemiological Results

### 3.1 Force of Infection Over Time

```{r foi-extraction}
#| label: foi-extraction

extract_lambda_base <- function(probs = c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975)) {
 lambda_mat <- as.matrix(fit, pars = "lambda_base_ys")
 idx <- stringr::str_match(colnames(lambda_mat), "lambda_base_ys\\[(\\d+),(\\d+)\\]")
 
 param_map <- tibble(
   par = colnames(lambda_mat),
   y_idx = as.integer(idx[, 2]),
   s_idx = as.integer(idx[, 3])
 )
 
 as_tibble(lambda_mat) |>
   mutate(.draw = row_number()) |>
   pivot_longer(cols = -.draw, names_to = "par", values_to = "lambda_base") |>
   left_join(param_map, by = "par") |>
   group_by(y_idx, s_idx) |>
   summarize(
     mean = mean(lambda_base),
     q025 = quantile(lambda_base, probs[1]),
     q500 = quantile(lambda_base, probs[2]),
     q975 = quantile(lambda_base, probs[3]),
     .groups = "drop"
   ) |>
   mutate(
     province = site_levels[s_idx],
     year = min(calendar$year) + y_idx - 1,
     region = region_levels[s_idx]
   )
}

lambda_data <- extract_lambda_base()
```

```{r foi-plot}
#| label: foi-plot
#| fig-cap: "Estimated baseline force of infection converted to yearly incidence per 100,000"

lambda_data |>
 mutate(
   yearly_mean = (1 - exp(-12 * mean)) * 1e5,
   yearly_q025 = (1 - exp(-12 * q025)) * 1e5,
   yearly_q975 = (1 - exp(-12 * q975)) * 1e5
 ) |>
 ggplot(aes(x = year, y = yearly_mean, color = province, fill = province)) +
 geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = yearly_q025, ymax = yearly_q975), alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
 geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
 facet_wrap(~region, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
 labs(
   x = "Year", y = "Yearly Incidence per 100,000",
   title = "Force of Infection → Yearly Incidence by Region"
 ) +
 theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
 theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

### 3.2 Case Detection Sensitivity

```{r sensitivity-plot}
#| label: sensitivity-plot
#| fig-cap: "Temporal evolution of case detection sensitivity by region"

Se_mat <- as.matrix(fit, pars = "Se_y")
idx <- stringr::str_match(colnames(Se_mat), "Se_y\\[(\\d+),(\\d+)\\]")

Se_summ <- tibble(par = colnames(Se_mat), r_idx = as.integer(idx[, 2]), y_idx = as.integer(idx[, 3])) |>
 left_join(
   as_tibble(Se_mat) |>
     mutate(.draw = row_number()) |>
     pivot_longer(cols = -.draw, names_to = "par", values_to = "Se"),
   by = "par"
 ) |>
 group_by(r_idx, y_idx) |>
 summarize(
   mean = mean(Se), q025 = quantile(Se, 0.025), q975 = quantile(Se, 0.975),
   .groups = "drop"
 ) |>
 mutate(
   year = min(calendar$year) + y_idx - 1,
   region = paste0("Region ", r_idx)
 )

ggplot(Se_summ, aes(x = year)) +
 geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = q025, ymax = q975), fill = "darkgreen", alpha = 0.3) +
 geom_line(aes(y = mean), color = "darkgreen", linewidth = 1) +
 facet_wrap(~region, ncol = 2) +
 scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = percent) +
 labs(x = "Year", y = "Detection Sensitivity", 
      title = "Case Detection Sensitivity Over Time") +
 theme_bw(base_size = 12)
```

### 3.3 Age-Specific Susceptibility

```{r age-susceptibility}
#| label: age-susceptibility
#| fig-cap: "Relative susceptibility by age group (reference: 25-35 years = 1)"

rho_mat <- as.matrix(fit, pars = "rho_pa")
idx <- stringr::str_match(colnames(rho_mat), "rho_pa\\[(\\d+),(\\d+)\\]")

rho_summ <- tibble(par = colnames(rho_mat), p_idx = as.integer(idx[, 2]), a_idx = as.integer(idx[, 3])) |>
 left_join(
   as_tibble(rho_mat) |> mutate(.draw = row_number()) |>
     pivot_longer(cols = -.draw, names_to = "par", values_to = "rho"),
   by = "par"
 ) |>
 group_by(p_idx, a_idx) |>
 summarize(
   mean = mean(rho), q025 = quantile(rho, 0.025), q975 = quantile(rho, 0.975),
   .groups = "drop"
 ) |>
 mutate(
   period = paste0("Period ", p_idx),
   age_group = age_levels[a_idx]
 )

ggplot(rho_summ, aes(x = age_group, y = mean, fill = period)) +
 geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
 geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = q025, ymax = q975), 
               position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.3) +
 geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
 scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "cividis") +
 labs(x = "Age Group", y = "Relative Susceptibility (ρ)", 
      title = "Age-Specific Relative Susceptibility") +
 theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
 theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

### 3.4 Case-Fatality Rate by Age

```{r cfr-plot}
#| label: cfr-plot
#| fig-cap: "Estimated case-fatality rate by age group and period"

CFR_mat <- as.matrix(fit, pars = "CFR_pa")
idx <- stringr::str_match(colnames(CFR_mat), "CFR_pa\\[(\\d+),(\\d+)\\]")

CFR_summ <- tibble(par = colnames(CFR_mat), p_idx = as.integer(idx[, 2]), a_idx = as.integer(idx[, 3])) |>
 left_join(
   as_tibble(CFR_mat) |> mutate(.draw = row_number()) |>
     pivot_longer(cols = -.draw, names_to = "par", values_to = "CFR"),
   by = "par"
 ) |>
 group_by(p_idx, a_idx) |>
 summarize(
   mean = mean(CFR), q025 = quantile(CFR, 0.025), q975 = quantile(CFR, 0.975),
   .groups = "drop"
 ) |>
 mutate(
   period = paste0("Period ", p_idx),
   age_group = factor(age_levels[a_idx], levels = age_levels)
 )

ggplot(CFR_summ, aes(x = age_group, y = mean * 100, color = period, group = period)) +
 geom_point(size = 3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
 geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = q025 * 100, ymax = q975 * 100), 
               width = 0.3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
 geom_line(position = position_dodge(width = 0.5), alpha = 0.5) +
 scale_color_viridis_d(option = "magma", end = 0.8) +
 labs(x = "Age Group", y = "Case-Fatality Rate (%)", 
      title = "Case-Fatality Rate by Age and Period") +
 theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
 theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

## 4. Seasonality Patterns

```{r seasonality}
#| label: seasonality
#| fig-cap: "Estimated seasonal multiplier by month and province"

# Extract seasonal multiplier if available
if ("seasonal_multiplier" %in% fit@sim$pars_oi) {
 seas_mat <- as.matrix(fit, pars = "seasonal_multiplier")
 idx <- stringr::str_match(colnames(seas_mat), "seasonal_multiplier\\[(\\d+),(\\d+),(\\d+)\\]")
 
 seas_summ <- tibble(
   par = colnames(seas_mat),
   m_idx = as.integer(idx[, 2]),
   p_idx = as.integer(idx[, 3]),
   s_idx = as.integer(idx[, 4])
 ) |>
   left_join(
     as_tibble(seas_mat) |> mutate(.draw = row_number()) |>
       pivot_longer(cols = -.draw, names_to = "par", values_to = "mult"),
     by = "par"
   ) |>
   group_by(m_idx, p_idx, s_idx) |>
   summarize(mean = mean(mult), .groups = "drop") |>
   mutate(
     month = factor(month.abb[m_idx], levels = month.abb),
     province = site_levels[s_idx],
     period = paste0("Period ", p_idx)
   )
 
 ggplot(seas_summ |> filter(p_idx == 1), aes(x = month, y = mean, group = province, color = province)) +
   geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
   geom_point(size = 2) +
   geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
   labs(x = "Month", y = "Seasonal Multiplier", 
        title = "Seasonal Pattern by Province (Period 1)") +
   theme_bw(base_size = 12)
} else {
 cat("Seasonal multiplier not available in model output.")
}
```

 )
